content.title: Q&A - Newsroom | Publix Super Markets
content.text: This is the main content. Financial Performance Does Publix report on the financial performance of specific products, categories, departments and/or stores? Legal Does Publix comment on pending litigation? What is Publix's policy on service animals? Media requests Does Publix allow filming inside their stores? Do Publix associates participate in media interviews? Do Publix executives participate in media interviews? Does Publix provide surveillance video footage to their media partners? Pharmacy Why has Publix Pharmacy decided to sunset their free prescription program effective June 1, 2022? Will Publix be administering the COVID-19 vaccine to children younger than 5 years of age? Political support Can Publix comment on the political contributions of family members? Does Publix comment on their political contributions? Why does Publix engage in the political process? Real estate When does Publix comment on new sites? Services Why does Publix not participate in lottery stories? Solicitation What is Publix's policy on solicitation? Store operations Which holidays are Publix stores closed? Supply chain What is Publix's pricing practice? What is Publix's position on animal welfare? What is Publix's position on antibiotic stewardship? What is Publix's position on cage-free eggs? What is Publix's position on the CIW? Why are there supply shortages at retail? Sustainability What is Publix's commitment to sustainability? Why does Publix offer the use of plastic bags?
